title: 第1701章 世家终定第1700章 不战而胜
lines: 众多修士本以为会有幸瞧见一场龙争虎斗，哪曾想冰灵尊者竟然直接认输了。
“可惜啊，冰灵尊者修成传闻中的朱雀真身，必然拥有合体大圆满的神通，还以为能瞧见一场大战呢。”
“谁说不是，老夫未曾瞧见剑洲的旷世大战，本以为此番能有所获，哎……终究是失算了。”
“你们这些老家伙……冰灵尊者此举实乃大智慧。玄衣尊者虽替萧家出战，但毕竟不是世家血脉，纵然力挫所有人，萧家也不可能取得天乾令，而冰灵尊者虽认输，朱家却已稳坐八大世家之首了。”
广场周围的议论之声并未避讳旁人，众人听闻此话，也露出恍然大悟之色。
唯萧离尘无奈苦笑。
毕竟，那位上古宗门的道友，所言半点不虚。
但萧离尘心中却另有激动。
无他，如今萧家虽未出战，却已可确定地坤令归属，实在让他心潮澎湃，而这一切，都因身旁这位玄袍青年。
他愈发感觉，当初不顾一切邀请王扶，乃他修炼生涯中的“神之一手”。
这时，一道五色霞光自王扶身上飞出，盘旋之后，落在王扶与萧离尘之间的茶几之上，化作一团拳头大小的五色火焰。
正是萧家帝炎真火，帝灵。
“拜见帝灵老祖！”
众多萧家修士立马起身，拱手拜见。
“啧啧……没想到萧家有朝一日还能步入八大世家前三，当真是出乎意料啊，如此机缘，还要多亏王道友了。”火焰摇曳，继而幻化出一个双目灵动的绝色女子形象，恍若火之精灵一般，却并未理会萧家众人，而是极为郑重地朝着王扶欠身施礼。
“帝灵道友客气，王某可什么也没做。”王扶轻笑一声。
“什么也没做，却也什么都做了，不管如何，本帝火替萧家做决定了，王道友今后定然登上那圣皇之位，我萧家届时愿为圣皇麾下，以供圣皇驱使。”帝灵一脸认真的看着王扶。
而此话一出，萧家众修士顿时一惊，可面面相觑之后，却无人反驳。
以帝灵真火的意思，是要将萧家彻底绑在这位玄衣尊者身上，为其麾下，一荣俱荣，一损……俱损。
“在下也是这个意思。”萧离尘心思急转，当即起身拱手道。
“两位言重了，圣皇之事可还有百年，届时如何，谁又说得准呢。”王扶倒是没想到这帝火如此果断，并未同意，当然也未拒绝。
不过以八大世家的身份甘愿拜入一圣皇麾下，此事纵观人族，也极为罕见。
毕竟，八大世家的地位仅次于圣皇，甚至有望争夺圣皇之位，可一旦归入一位圣皇麾下，便从此绝了这一条路。
“本帝火肯定相信王道友能够功成的。”帝灵一笑道，虽说王扶并未同意，却也并未拒绝。
“那就借帝灵道友吉言了。”
王扶一笑。
几人谈话这点空隙，空中两个金色气泡中早已再次出现了强大的神通波动。
右侧自不必说，乃是其他世家之人正在比试，而左侧金色气泡内，却是那崔家鬼尊与东方世家的丹尊正在激烈斗法。
两人神通均是不弱，王扶也不觉凝视而去。
毕竟，不出意外今后与这位鬼尊打交道的时候不少，如今也正好可以瞧一瞧对方的神通。
虽说此人与澹台世家的太上大长老早有过斗法，但二者修为相差不少，自然不能让此人用出全力。
可东方世家这位丹尊，也是一位顶尖尊者。
果不其然，这位鬼尊见祭出的领域也奈何不得那位丹尊，脸色一沉之下，直接捏诀，口中喷出诡异的绿色火焰，席卷长空。
在其手中一尊鬼气森森的古怪大印也脱手而出，朝着丹尊镇压而去。
那绿色鬼火分明也是一种极为厉害的真火，阴气森然，似来自地狱一般，化作一尊偌大的真火骷髅，配合那高阶玄天灵宝的古怪鬼印，威力无穷。
然而丹尊却冷笑一声，大手一挥，竟是直接祭出三道玄光。
玄光一转，竟露出三尊模样各异的高阶玄天灵宝。
一镜，一锤，一锥。
一股庞大的神魂之力落在三件灵宝之上，天地元气汇聚，三件至宝立马光芒大盛。
古镜翻转，射出玄光，将那鬼印罩住，后者立马一滞。
content_en:
Many monks thought they would be lucky enough to witness a fight between dragons and tigers, but they never thought that Lord Ice Spirit would admit defeat directly.
"What a pity. Lord Ice Spirit has cultivated the rumored Suzaku true form, and must have the magical power of the Great Perfection. He thought he could see a big battle."
"Who says otherwise? I have never witnessed the great battle in Jianzhou. I thought I would gain something from this, but... I made a miscalculation after all."
"You old guys... Venerable Ice Ling's move is really great wisdom. Although Venerable Xuanyi fights for the Xiao family, he is not of the family's blood after all. Even if he defeats everyone, the Xiao family will not be able to obtain the Heavenly Stem Order. However, even though Venerable Ice Ling admits defeat, the Zhu family has firmly become the leader of the eight aristocratic families."
…
The discussion around the square did not shy away from others, and when everyone heard this, they also showed signs of enlightenment.
Only Xiao Lichen smiled helplessly.
After all, what that fellow Taoist from the ancient sect said was absolutely true.
But Xiao Lichen had other emotions in his heart.
Without him, now that the Xiao family has not gone to war, it is certain that Kun Ling belongs to him, which really makes his heart surge, and all this is because of this young man in black robes beside him.
He felt more and more that his desperate invitation to Wang Fu was the "hand of God" in his cultivation career.
At this time, a five-color glow flew out from Wang Fu's body, circled, and landed on the coffee table between Wang Fu and Xiao Lichen, turning into a five-color flame the size of a fist.
It is the Xiao family’s Emperor Yan Zhenhuo, the Emperor’s Spirit.
"Meet the Ancestor Emperor Ling!"
Many Xiao family monks immediately stood up and bowed their hands in greeting.
"Tsk, tsk... I didn't expect that the Xiao family would one day be among the top three of the eight aristocratic families. It was really unexpected. Such an opportunity is all thanks to fellow Taoist Wang." The flames swayed, and then transformed into the image of a stunning woman with lively eyes, like a fire elf. However, she paid no attention to the Xiao family, but bowed to Wang Fu with great solemnity.
"Fellow Di Ling is polite, but Wang didn't do anything." Wang Fu chuckled.
"I have done nothing, but I have done everything. No matter what, I have made the decision for the Xiao family. Wang Daoyou will definitely ascend to the position of the Holy Emperor in the future. I, the Xiao family, are willing to serve under the Holy Emperor and be driven by the Holy Emperor." Emperor Ling looked at Wang Fu seriously.
As soon as these words came out, all the monks in the Xiao family were shocked, but after looking at each other, no one refuted.
The intention of the Emperor's True Fire is to completely tie the Xiao family to this Venerable Xuanyi, and under his command, they will be both prosperous and devastated.
"That's what I mean." Xiao Lichen's mind suddenly changed and he immediately stood up and cupped his hands.
"You two have spoken seriously. The Holy Emperor will still have a hundred years to go. Who can say for sure what will happen by then." Wang Fu did not expect that the Emperor Huo would be so decisive. He did not agree, and of course he did not reject it.
However, as one of the eight great aristocratic families, he was willing to serve under a holy emperor. This was extremely rare in the human race.
After all, the status of the eight major families is second only to the Holy Emperor, and they are even expected to compete for the Holy Emperor's position. However, once they fall under the command of a Holy Emperor, this path will never happen.
"I, Emperor Huo, definitely believe that Fellow Daoist Wang can succeed." Emperor Ling said with a smile. Although Wang Fu did not agree, he did not reject it either.
"Then let me borrow Ji Ling's words from Taoist friend Di Ling."
Wang Fu smiled.
While several people were talking, powerful magical fluctuations appeared in the two golden bubbles in the air.
Needless to say, on the right side, people from other aristocratic families were competing, while on the left side, inside the golden bubble, the Cui Family Ghost Lord and the Alchemy Lord of the Dongfang Family were having a fierce battle.
Both of their magical powers were not weak, and Wang Fu stared away without realizing it.
After all, as expected, I will have to deal with this ghost lord a lot in the future, and now I can just take a look at his magical powers.
Although this person had already fought with the Taishang Elder of the Tantai family, their cultivation levels were quite different, so naturally they could not let this person use his full strength.
But this Alchemy Master of the Dongfang Family is also a top sage.
As expected, when the Ghost Lord saw the sacrificed domain, he had nothing to do with the Alchemy Lord. His face sank, and he directly kneaded the formula, and spewed out strange green flames from his mouth, sweeping across the sky.
A strange and ghostly big seal in his hand also came out of his hand and moved towards Dan Zun to suppress it.
The green will-o'-the-wisp is clearly an extremely powerful true fire, with a sinister air that seems to come from hell. It turns into a huge true fire skeleton, and combined with the weird ghost seal of the high-level Xuantian Lingbao, it is infinitely powerful.
However, Alchemy Master sneered and waved his hand, directly shooting out three mysterious lights.
The mysterious light turned, revealing three high-level Xuantian spiritual treasures with different appearances.
A mirror, a hammer, a cone.
A huge divine soul power fell on the three spiritual treasures, the energy of heaven and earth gathered together, and the three treasures immediately shone brightly.
The ancient mirror flipped over and shot out a mysterious light, covering the ghost seal, which immediately froze.
title_en: Chapter 1701 The Family is Finalized Chapter 1700 Victory without Fighting
